text: “Shared” means every output cell reuses the same 3 by 3 filter, called K — it slides instead of using new weights.
Look at the diagram: this red 3 by 3 patch reads nine numbers and produces one green output.
Slide that same patch right and down, and each new output uses those identical nine weights.
So instead of eighty-one separate weights you learn nine, and the model gets far fewer parameters to train.
